summary: Licence gap found while assessing whether to build a LanPaint-derived sampler into MpiNodes. The pack is PUBLIC on GitHub with no LICENSE and published to the Comfy registry (928 downloads, latest 1.2.6). Fabio chose AGPL-3.0 to match Cubric-Vision: the licence becomes the moat he was previously trying to get by withholding registry releases, which could never work since both repos are public and Manager installs from a git URL.

Claimed three files in the SIBLING repo c:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes (LICENSE, pyproject.toml, README.md) plus a new Vision playbook at docs/playbooks/upstream-contributions/README.md. Sibling repo is separate git - use git -C, never a bare git from Vision.

Shipped: AGPL-3.0 landed on ComfyUi-MpiNodes (ee85c98) and 1.2.7 pushed to the Comfy registry with 29 backlogged changelog entries, changelog PUT accepted HTTP 200. Registry license field now reads {"file": "LICENSE"} instead of the dangling {"text": "LICENSE"} it served to 928 downloads. Note this was a RELICENCE not a gap-fill - the README declared MIT at line 213, which nobody had noticed; clean to do since Fabio is sole author (65 commits, 0 PRs, 1 contributor), and 1.2.6-and-earlier keep their MIT grant, stated explicitly in the README. Registry scan verdict on 1.2.7 still Pending - the same scanner banned 19 consecutive versions Apr-Jul 2026 before Fabio resolved it with support, so Active is the thing to confirm, not assume.
